question: Who stands behind NEAR’s validators? Make me a fresh flower with their backers, not an existing one.

There's an existing published flower, but you asked for a fresh one, so I'll build a new analysis. The snapshot is the final stored data (block 222,915,356, 2026‑11‑03 — final data is never re-fetched, so it was reused). Counting now:

interpretation.summary: Each petal is a NEAR staking pool (validator), sized by its stake this epoch. The ring inside each bar splits that stake by who delegated to the pool: other delegators, accounts with 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts and lockups. Top pools are led mostly by small delegators, with liquid staking and whale accounts visible in the segment mix.

power_means.claim: Power here is validator stake in the current epoch: how much NEAR the pool's delegators have staked with it. More stake means more blocks produced and more protocol influence.
Stake is delegated: each pool's power is the sum of its delegators, so the backer segments show who actually stands behind each validator.

mappings.why: each petal's width is the pool's share of current-epoch stake, log-compressed into a band so small pools stay visible
bar height is the square root of the pool's stake share, the default scale for reading magnitude
colour marks kind of account (staking pool, liquid-staking contract, unknown) as listed by the snapshot
outline shows identity status: solid for self-declared or verified names, dashed for inferred, none when unknown
the question asks who stands behind each validator; segments: backers splits each pool's delegated stake into other delegators, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts and lockups
largest stake first, clockwise from the top, so the most important pools are read in order

conflicts: Liquid-staking token holders (e.g. STNEAR holders) hold economic power over the contracts that delegate, but Petal shows only the contracts as backers, not their token holders.
Block production rate is a second axis of validator power (some pools underproduce); this flower draws stake, not production.
Governance power (House of Stake, veNEAR) is a different network Petal reads separately; it is not shown here.
unknowns: Delegators of the 424 idle pools were not crawled, so their backer mixes are missing.
Liquid-staking contracts' own token holders are not listed; only the contract appears as a backer.
Lockup contract owners were not resolved; a lockup backer is not identified to a person.
Pool owners (get_owner_id) appear as kind 'unknown' and are not identified.
Delegations under 1,000 NEAR are folded into one group row per pool and backer class, so individual small backers are not visible.
Identities are self-declared (pool-details.near or named account ids), not verified ownership.
inferred: Top pools being backed mostly by many small delegators is read from the segment shares; the snapshot declares this split per pool but small delegated rows are folded, so exact small-backer composition is approximate.
